title: Role
description: An Ansible role published on Galaxy, containing tasks, handlers, defaults, templates, and metadata for reuse across playbooks.

id.description: Unique numeric identifier for the role.

namespace.description: Galaxy namespace (usually GitHub username) of the role author.

description.description: Short description of what the role does.
description.example: Installs and configures Nginx web server.

github_user.description: GitHub username of the role author.

github_repo.description: GitHub repository name for this role.

github_branch.description: Default branch for this role's repository.

download_count.description: Total number of times this role has been downloaded.

stargazers_count.description: Number of GitHub stars for this role.

forks_count.description: Number of GitHub forks for this role.

open_issues_count.description: Number of open GitHub issues for this role.

min_ansible_version.description: Minimum Ansible version required by this role.

created.description: When this role was first published to Galaxy.

modified.description: When this role was last updated.
